text:
Hi there, and thank you for contacting Leafy! I'm so sorry your plant arrived frozen and black, especially when you needed it for your event. That's really disappointing.

I want to be upfront about our policy. When a weather hold is waived, the Plant Care Guarantee still applies, **except for cold or heat damage in transit**. Damage-on-arrival claims for cold or heat damage aren't accepted in that case. So I can't promise a free replacement under the standard policy, and I don't want to give you false hope.

I can still pass your situation to a Support Lead, who can review whether an exception is possible. I can't guarantee the outcome, and I don't have a set timeframe for their review. To help them, please have these ready:

- Photos of the plant and the box
- Your order number
- The date it was delivered

Would you like me to escalate this for you? Also, if any part of the plant looks like it might still be alive, our Plant Care Specialists offer free advice by chat or email.

Thanks for your patience, and please reach out anytime. We'd love to help you get a healthy plant for your next event. 🌿
